title: Leibniz estimate for the iterated derivatives of f·g (smooth function times smooth k-form) under the frozen imports
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ and let g : ℝ^P → Λ^k(ℝ^P) be C^∞, where Λ^k(ℝ^P) = Covector (Euclid P) k is the space of continuous alternating k-linear forms with its operator norm; C^∞ means ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞). Then for every n ∈ ℕ and every x ∈ ℝ^P, ‖D^n(f·g)(x)‖ ≤ Σ_{i=0}^{n} C(n, i)·‖D^i f(x)‖·‖D^{n−i} g(x)‖, where f·g is x ↦ f(x)•g(x), D^i = iteratedFDeriv ℝ i, and ‖·‖ is the operator norm of continuous multilinear maps. (This is Mathlib's norm_iteratedFDeriv_smul_le, whose module Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Bounds is not in the frozen import closure of GMT.Ch07.Submission, so it must be proved here.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) k), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Euclid P), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f y • g y) x‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g x‖
